title: Calibration Station — Fault: torque drift
author: B. Technician
content: On 2026-02-03 the calibration station reported torque drift exceeding the 4.2 N·m setpoint by 0.6 N·m. Root cause was a worn drive coupling. Resolution: the coupling was replaced and the station re-zeroed. After the fix, torque held within 0.05 N·m over a 200-unit test run. Related component: drive coupling DC-17.
